approval.note: Gates chosen by the implementing agent from plan section 10 (refusal recall 100%, clarify recall >= 95%) and zero-guess, zero-execution, and no-confidence-claim rules. Not approved.

not_measured.real_model_abstention: the model is replaced by chosen outputs; a real model's tendency to guess is not measured
not_measured.calibration: no model confidence exists to calibrate; the system claims none, and calibration of a real model's confidence is not evaluated
not_measured.near_miss_questions: the intent-echo check is lexical: it compares the question's words with certified terms, so a near-miss that reuses certified words can still pass, and an unusual phrasing of a valid question can be refused; it does not understand meaning
